While the claim adds specific implementation details about transforming point P into the local coordinate system using orientation Q and center C (which are standard geometric operations for evaluating a cuboid SDF and are implied by the function name `evaluate_sdf_cuboid` in a graphics context), the core logic described in the claim (iterating cuboids, evaluating SDF, updating min_dist) is fully supported by the evidence in [S1]. The evidence confirms the loop structure and the update rule.
